entities.summary: Vladimir "Vlado" Petrović-Stergiou is a Serbian-Greek former professional basketball player. At 6 ft 6 1⁄2 in tall, he played at the shooting guard and small forward positions. He is also known as Vlantimir Stergiou, which is his Greek-form name.
